text: Per the FNC's own structure page, the Comité Nacional de Cafeteros — the body that agrees coffee policy between the federation and the government, which exists because the FNC is the national government's delegate to administer the National Coffee Fund (FoNC), an account of public coffee funds — is made up of four national-government representatives (the Ministers of Finance, Agriculture and Trade and the head of the National Planning Department) plus the members of the federation's Comité Directivo.

source.name: Federación Nacional de Cafeteros: 'Estructura'
source.quote: Conformado por 4 representantes del Gobierno: Ministro de Hacienda, Ministro de Agricultura, Ministro de Comercio y Director de Planeación Nacional; más los integrantes del Comité Directivo.
source.note: Spanish quote, translation: 'Made up of 4 representatives of the Government: the Minister of Finance, Minister of Agriculture, Minister of Trade and Director of National Planning; plus the members of the Comité Directivo.' The same section describes the committee as the Órgano de concertación de la política cafetera entre el gremio y el Gobierno (the body where coffee policy is agreed between the federation and the government), established because the FNC administers the Fondo Nacional del Café (FoNC), 'cuenta de recursos públicos cafeteros' (an account of public coffee funds), as the national government's delegate.
